Treatment of road accident victims
†*421. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
contemplating to bring in a scheme of  'Road
Safety System' in all the districts of the
country for treatment of the injured persons
keeping in view the fact that such persons
die in road accidents on highways every
now and then;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of the persons killed in
road accidents during the last five years,
State-wise?
Prime Minister's Russia visit
*422. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA :
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether a ministerial level delegation
led by Prime Minister visited Moscow,
recently;
(b) if so, the composition of the team
thereof;
(c) the expenditure incurred thereon;
(d) whether Government have signed
any MoU during the visit; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Ahmedabad-Vadodara express way
*423. SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
SHRI LEKHRAJ BACHANI:
 Will the Minister of SHIPPING,
ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that extension of
Ahmedabad-Vadodara express way upto
Mumbai is being proposed under National
Highway Development Programme;
(b) whether Government are aware that
Gujarat has frozen development in a band
of 300 mts. on either side of finalized
alignment; and
(c) if so, the time-frame for acquisition
of land and the starting of the project?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Quality of mobile services
†*424. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to refer to answer to Unstarred
Question 143 given in Rajya Sabha on the
24th November, 2005 and state:
(a) according to the regulations issued
by the Telecom Regulatory Authority of
India on 8th July, 2005 what are the revised
criterions pertaining to the quality of
service;
(b) on which locations quality of service
was found below the quality standards
fixed by TRAI for these services;
(c) whether due to paucity of Base
Station Tower (BST) the subscribers do
not receive SMSs on time especially on the
eve of festivals, but they are charged for
these services; and
(d) if so, what steps Government are
taking to check this situation?
Coal extraction by "Coal-Videsh"
†*425. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that an institute
by the name of 'Coal-Videsh' was
constituted by the Government for
purchase of coal mines, etc. abroad;
(b) if so, the date of constitution of the
said institute and the number of persons
appointed therein category-wise; and
(c) the number of coal mines etc.
purchased from abroad by the said institute
upto October, 2005?
Growth of KVI sector
*426. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN:
DR. K. MALAISAMY:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether enough priority and
importance are given to the growth and
development of Khadi and Village Industries
sector in the wake of its vital role in rural
economy and employment;
(b) if so, what is the budgetary support
given under Plan and non-Plan and the flow
of institutional finance during the last three
years as against its requirement; and
(c) what are the core reasons for the
decline and fall of this sector after its golden
age for about three decades during 50s to
80s?
Investment in WI-MAX infrastructure
*427. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND INFOR-
MATION TECHNOLOGY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Bharat Sanchar Nigam Ltd.
(BSNL) and MTNL are planning to invest
in WI-MAX infrastructure;
(b) if so, the total investment being
planned in this sector; and
(c) what are the services and
applications that can be offered on WI-
MAX technology?
Land reclaimed by MCL
†*428. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the land reclaimed after levelling and
filling where mining of coal had been done
in the last ten years in the country;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

132
(b) the land thus reclaimed in the last
ten years by Mahanadi Coalfields Ltd. at
Sambalpur, Orissa;
(c) whether the land reclaimed by MCL
is likely to be used for some other purpose;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, whether Government would
consider to give the said land to its owners?
59th report of NSS on agriculture
†*429. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) what are the details of the 59th
survey report of NSS on agriculture and
farmers and the reaction of Planning
Commission thereto;
(b) whether due to non-provision of
loans to farmers, particularly medium and
marginal farmers they had to take loan from
money lenders;
(c) whether condition of farmers has
worsened due to inadequate irrigation,
drought and also due to not getting the fair
price of agricultural produce;
(d) whether as a result of this, most of
the farmers want to get rid of farming; and
(e) if so, the steps Government are
taking to improve their condition and make
them free from debt?
More expenditure on delayed projects
†*430. SHRI LEKHRAJ BACHANI:
PROF. R.B.S. VARMA:
Will the Minister of STATISTICS AND
PROGRAMME IMPLEMENTATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to not
taking-up various Government approved
projects on time or non-completion of these
projects in stipulated time-period,
Government have to spend more money
on them;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps being taken by Govern-
ment to complete these projects on time?
Bridge on River Zuari
*431. SHRI SHANT ARAM
LAXMAN NAIK: Will the Minister of
SHIPPING, ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
build a second bridge on the River Zuari in
Goa;
(b) the details of the proposal, if any,
made by the State Government; and
(c) the cost involved in the construction
of the bridge?
White passports to dancers
*432. SHRIMATI BIMBA RAIKAR:
Will the PRIME MINISTERbe pleased to
state:
(a) whether a troupe of Bhangra dancers
from Punjab was given white passports to
visit Germany in September, 2005 to
perform under a cultural exchange
programme;
(b) whether the antecedents of the
members of the troupe were checked before
issuing the white passports;
(c) whether more than half of the
members disappeared after a few
performances and still remain untraced by
German authorities; and
(d) whether the German Government
has issued a note of concern and if so,
Government of India's comments
 thereon?

133
Agreement of scientific
collaborations
*433. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
Will the Minister of SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) with how many countries the
bilateral agreements of scientific
collaboration and exchanges have been
signed;
(b) whether these agreements permit the
scientists and academicians from these
countries to take up medium or long term
faculty positions and research assignments
in the academic and research institutions in
the country;
(c) if so, the details of such long and
medium term visitors in last three years;
and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Cases being handled by CBI
*434. SHRI PRASANTA CHATTER-
JEE: Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of cases being handled
by CBI as on the 30th June, 2005;
(b) the number of cases being
investigated into by CBI for more than five,
ten and fifteen years;
(c) the number of officers and staff
posted in CBI; and
(d) whether Government think that the
present sanctioned strength is enough
to handle the increased work-load
effectively?
Scientific Citation Index
*435. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the number
of scientific papers from the country that
are included in Scientific Citation Index have
gone down over the years;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) what steps are being taken to
improve the situation; and
(d) the number of foreign scientific
publications that have shown inclination
to set up their publications in India ever
since the policy to permit FDI in publishing
scientific journals was enunciated?
Telephone exchanges damaged by
naxalites
*436. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
was helpless in connecting many villages
across the country due to naxalite problem;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that at many
places the naxalites damaged the telephone
exchanges; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Scheme for people displaced by coal
companies
*437. SHRI V. NARAYANASAMY:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have

134
formulated a scheme for the people
displaced due to land acquisition for the 45
coal projects to be executed by the State
owned coal companies; and
(b) if so, the features of  the scheme for
protecting interest of the people who have
been displaced?
Constitution of National Commission
on Enterprises
†*438. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government had
constituted a National Commission on
Enterprises in the unorganised and informal
sector;
(b) if so, when the said Commission
was constituted and by when its report
was estimated to be received;
(c) whether the said report has been
received and if so, its salient features; and
(d) the decision taken by the Govern-
ment on the basis of recommendations made
in the report?
Four-laning of National Highways in
Arunachal Pradesh
*439. SHRI NABAM REBIA: Will the
Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) the names of National Highways
selected for four-laning in the Noth Eastern
Region, particularly in the State of
Arunachal Pradesh;
(b) the number of proposals for
improving the National Highways and
other roads received from the above State;
(c) the details of funds earmarked and
spent on the above works; and
(d) by when these works would be
completed?
Single lane National Highways in
Rajasthan
*440. SHRI THENNALA G.
BALAKRISHNA
PILLAI:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that still there are
National Highways in Rajasthan of single
lane and intermediate lane;
(b) if so, what steps are being taken by
Government to make them two-lane;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
periodic renewal and maintenance funds
allocated for the National Highways in
Rajasthan is inadequate; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor and by
when balance funds would be allocated?
NEW DELHI; YOGENDRA NARAIN,
The 16th December, 2005 Secretary-General.

Sale of Khadi products
3197. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN:
DR. K. MALAISAMY:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Khadi products could not
compete with other similar products in the
open market in view of low productivity
and high cost of Khadi products;
(b) if so, the measures to promote and
protect them from this threat;
(c) whether Government are aware that
there are umpteen number of fake and
bogus products in the open market and
even in the Khadi Vastralaya outlets under
the name and style of Khadi and are sold at
cheaper rates than that of Khadi products;
and

this evil?

Industries
†3198. SHRI LAXMINARAYAN
SHARMA: Will the Minister of AGRO

to state:
(a) the progress made in Khadi and
Village Industries during the last three years;
(b) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the measures being taken to promote
and to popularize the Khadi and Village
Industries; and
(d) whether there is any proposal to
provide financial assistance for the same?

Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL

revamped;

village industries in the country during each

introduce some of the schemes that would

village industries;

take up a good portion of REGP Schemes

give employment to rural poor in a big
way;
(b) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the remedial measures planned to
help this sector?

Board has also demanded a nuclear power
plant for the State; and

officers;

accused but not suspended officers do not
affect the inquiry against them; and
(d) the dates of initiating departmental
inquiry against each of the accused officers

inquiry?

raised in the Parliament but at that time

Government/department/corporation to
punish the persons found guilty, to remove

Access providers to implement CAC

implementing the CAC as on date;

the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS

Pradesh has requested Government to
waive inter-connectivity charges for e-
Governance applications for e-Seva and

Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND

pleased to state:

staff in the post offices in Delhi;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor, the cadre-

above mentioned categories of staff as on
the 1st November, 2005; and

fill the vacant posts expeditiously so as to
ensure that the people visiting post offices
do not have to stand in queues for unduly
long hours?
TRAI's directions to CDMA operators

Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Telecom
Regulator TRAI have received complaints
for disconnection of telephones by CDMA
operators even when the payments are
made regularly by the subscribers;

638
(b) if so, the details in this regard; and
(c) the steps taken by TRAI to warn
the CDMA operators for harassment to
subscribers?
Investment for infrastructure in NLD
markets

MANHAR: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether National Long Distance
(NLD) market requires a lot of investments
in creating infrastructure;
(b) if so, what are the total investments
made by NLD operators in creating
infrastructure in the country;
(c) what is the total NLD capacity
currently available in India and what are
the current utilization levels;
(d) whether the current infrastructure
is sufficient to cater to the projected
demand during the next three years; and
(e) if not, the steps being taken by
Government to create more infrastructures
in NLD market?
Production of handsets of mobile
phones

CARIAPPA: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
India depends for the production of
handsets of mobile phones on foreign
companies;
(b) if so, what measures are being taken
to encourage indigenous production
thereof;
(c) the number of Indian companies who
are producing such handsets;

at manufacturing of handsets are being
blocked; and
(e) the details thereof?

MURTHY: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the steps taken so far by B.S.N.L. in
Karnataka to promote the use of broadband
connections in Karnataka; and

proposed to be spent in this regard during
2005-06 in Karnataka?
Service tax on the largest source of
revenue

RAO: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
